title: Heteregenous Beliefs Recovery
authors: Julien Hugonnier, Darius Nik Nejad, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn, Fernanda Ortega 等
official: 官方在线 2025-05-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we develop an optimization-based method to approximate the implied distribution of consumption shares across beliefs, given discrete time series of prices and interest rates. We confirm the accuracy of this method on simulated data and illustrate the versatility of our approach by providing extensions of our basic recovery theorem that allow for learning and multidimensional beliefs.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于优化的方法，用于在给定价格和利率的离散时间序列的情况下，近似消费份额在信念上的隐含分布。我们通过模拟数据验证了该方法的准确性，并通过提供基本恢复定理的扩展（允许学习和多维信念）展示了我们方法的通用性。

title: DP748 Holes and Loopholes in Integration Agreements: History and Prospects
title_zh: 一体化协议中的漏洞与缺陷：历史与展望
title_primary: 一体化协议中的漏洞与缺陷：历史与展望
title_secondary: DP748 Holes and Loopholes in Integration Agreements: History and Prospects
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: It often appears self-evident that regional integration arrangements (RIAs) result in more far-reaching liberalization of intra-bloc trade than is possible if countries restrict themselves to a multilateral approach. This paper considers whether such arrangements do in fact imply, or facilitate, greater liberalization of trade flows among member countries than that achieved (or sought) in the multilateral (GATT) context. The underlying hypothesis is that the political-economy forces that block far-reaching liberalization in the multilateral context also remain robust and largely decisive in sculpting RIAs. The holes and loopholes - exceptions, sectoral exclusions, market-sharing arrangements and escape clauses of various kinds - embodied in major RIAs are examined to assess the degree to which existing RIAs have achieved liberalization beyond the prevailing multilateral trade policy regime. A number of lessons regarding the likely prevalence of, and scope for, holes and loopholes in alternative types of RIAs are drawn from the historical overview.
abstract_zh: 区域一体化安排（RIAs）往往看似不言而喻地能比各国局限于多边方式时实现更深入的区域内贸易自由化。本文探讨此类安排是否确实意味着或促进了成员国之间比多边（GATT）框架下所实现（或寻求）的更大程度的贸易自由化。其基本假设是：在多边背景下阻碍深度自由化的政治经济力量，在塑造区域一体化安排时同样强劲且具有决定性作用。本文考察了主要区域一体化安排中存在的漏洞与缺口——包括例外条款、部门排除、市场分割安排及各类逃避条款——以评估现有区域一体化安排超越现行多边贸易政策体制所实现的自由化程度。基于历史回顾，本文就不同类型区域一体化安排中漏洞与缺口的可能普遍性及范围得出了若干启示。

title: Critical Peak Rewards: Evidence from a Nationwide Demand Response Program
title_zh: 关键峰值奖励：来自全国需求响应项目的证据
title_primary: 关键峰值奖励：来自全国需求响应项目的证据
title_secondary: Critical Peak Rewards: Evidence from a Nationwide Demand Response Program
authors: Louise Bernard, Robert D. Metcalfe, Andrew Schein
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Demand flexibility at scale is likely to be an important part of the future energy system. This study evaluated the world’s first nationwide domestic and commercial demand flexibility program. We analyzed the policy using a natural field experiment, with a sample of 2.7 million, assigning 119,999 customers to a control group and the rest to receive randomized encouragement to sign up to the demand flexibility program. The program paid consumers to reduce their demand below a predicted baseline at peak demand across 16 events (i.e., when the system was stressed) during the Winter of 2023–24. Customers who opted into events reduced demand during events by 23.1% among compliers, at an average cost for the system operator of £2,325 per MWh. The adoption of solar panels and batteries, heat pumps, and EVs all increased demand response.
abstract_zh: 大规模需求灵活性很可能是未来能源系统的重要组成部分。本研究评估了全球首个全国性居民及商业需求灵活性项目。我们通过自然田野实验对该政策进行分析，样本规模达270万，其中119,999名客户被分配至对照组，其余客户则接受随机激励以注册参与需求灵活性项目。该项目在2023-24年冬季的16个高峰事件（即系统承压时段）中，向消费者支付费用以使其需求低于预测基线水平。在依从者中，选择参与事件的客户在事件期间实现了23.1%的需求削减，系统运营商的平均成本为每兆瓦时2325英镑。太阳能光伏板与电池、热泵及电动汽车的普及均提升了需求响应效果。

title: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
title_zh: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据
title_primary: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据
title_secondary: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
authors: Eric Chyn, Kareem Haggag, Bryan A. Stuart
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: How do majority groups respond to narrowing inequality in racially polarized environments? We study this by examining the Freedmen’s Bureau, an agency created after the US Civil War to aid former slaves and launch institutional reform in the South. Using new historical records and an event-study approach, we estimate the Bureau’s impact on political, social, and economic outcomes. Vote shares for Democrats, the party that previously championed slavery and opposed Black civil rights, initially eroded in Bureau counties, but these impacts faded as federal oversight weakened. Racial backlash emerged rapidly and persisted, suggesting White majorities sought to offset Black progress.
abstract_zh: 在种族极化环境中，多数群体如何应对日益缩小的不平等？我们通过研究美国内战后为援助前奴隶并在南方推行制度改革而设立的“自由民局”来探讨这一问题。利用新历史记录和事件研究方法，我们估算了该局对政治、社会和经济结果的影响。在自由民局覆盖的县，民主党（此前支持奴隶制并反对黑人公民权利的政党）的得票率最初有所下降，但随着联邦监督的减弱，这些影响逐渐消失。种族反弹迅速出现并持续存在，表明白人多数群体试图抵消黑人的进步。

title: No Place Like Home? The Causal Effect of Forced Relocation from Central Addis Ababa
title_zh: 行动中的区域一体化发展
title_primary: 行动中的区域一体化发展
title_secondary: No Place Like Home? The Causal Effect of Forced Relocation from Central Addis Ababa
authors: Bryan, Gharad, Franklin, Simon, Getahun, Tigabu, Winton, Sarah
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do central slums provide essential economic and social benefits to the poor? We collected bespoke data for 5,000 households to study mass forced clearances in Addis Ababa. Evictees were offered alternative subsidized housing further from the center. Exploiting sharp clearance zone boundaries, regression-discontinuity estimates show negative impacts on social networks, but positive impacts on work, earnings, housing quality and environmental amenity. Relocating households close to their ex-ante neighbors eliminates social costs. Slums are not essential: relocation policies can be designed to fully compensate residents, and the sale value of cleared land more than covers the cost.
abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的每个博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法有效超越了现有最先进的股价预测方法。

title: The Debt‐Equity Spread
authors: HUI CHEN, ZHIYAO CHEN, JUN LI
abstract: We propose a measure of the valuation gap between debt and equity—debt‐equity spread (DES)—based on the difference between actual and equity‐implied credit spreads. DES predicts cross‐sectional stock and bond returns in opposite directions. This predictability is unique compared to existing mispricing measures and cannot be explained by exposures to various risk factors. High‐DES firms are more likely to issue equity and retire debt, and have more insider equity selling. These findings are consistent with DES capturing relative mispricing between debt and equity, and provide empirical support for the model of partially segmented markets in Greenwood, Hanson, and Liao (2018, Review of Financial Studies 31, 3307–3343).
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量债务与股权估值差距的指标——债务-股权利差（DES），该指标基于实际信用利差与股权隐含信用利差之间的差异。DES能够反向预测股票和债券的横截面收益。这种预测能力相较于现有的错误定价指标具有独特性，且无法通过各类风险因子的暴露来解释。高DES企业更倾向于发行股票并偿还债务，同时内部人股权出售行为更为频繁。这些发现与DES捕捉债务与股权相对错误定价的结论一致，并为Greenwood、Hanson和Liao（2018，《金融研究评论》第31卷，第3307–3343页）提出的部分分割市场模型提供了实证支持。

title: The role of specialized knowledge and ‘know-how’ for firm productivity: Evidence from the equine sector
title_zh: 专业知识与“诀窍”对企业生产率的作用：来自马业部门的证据
title_primary: 专业知识与“诀窍”对企业生产率的作用：来自马业部门的证据

authors: Pia Nilsson, Hans Andersson, Tobias Heldt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using matched employer–employee data, we examine how workforce knowledge characteristics relate to firm productivity in the equine sector. Using panel data on Swedish equine firms from 2010 to 2022, we construct measures of workforce composition, including occupation-specific education, accumulated work experience and knowledge diversity. The results show that access to occupation-specific human capital is positively associated with productivity, with substantial heterogeneity across firms. Knowledge effects are stronger among firms specializing in horse racing than in breeding, highlighting differences in the role of human capital across production orientations. The findings have implications for policy and firms’ investment decisions.
abstract_zh: 利用匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我们研究了马业部门劳动力知识特征与企业生产率之间的关系。基于2010年至2022年瑞典马业企业的面板数据，我们构建了劳动力构成指标，包括职业特定教育、累积工作经验及知识多样性。结果表明，职业特定人力资本的获取与生产率呈正相关，且企业间存在显著异质性。相较于育种企业，赛马专营企业的知识效应更为显著，凸显了人力资本在不同生产导向中的差异化作用。该发现对政策制定及企业投资决策具有启示意义。

authors: David Arnold, Kevin Milligan, Terry S. Moon, Amirhossein Tavakoli
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper connects changes in employer characteristics through job transitions to employee earnings following mergers and acquisitions. Using firm balance sheet data linked to individual earnings data in Canada and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that earnings of workers at target firms decrease after M&As relative to control workers, largely driven by those who move to other firms. Workers leaving targets move to larger and more profitable firms, but still experience wage declines. These decreased earnings are also concentrated among workers with longer tenure. These results are consistent with workers losing valuable match-specific premia after M&A-induced job transitions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过工作转换将雇主特征的变化与并购后员工收入联系起来。利用加拿大企业资产负债表数据与个人收入数据的关联，并采用匹配双重差分法，我们发现目标企业员工在并购后的收入相对于对照组员工有所下降，这主要源于那些跳槽至其他企业的员工。离开目标企业的员工虽转向规模更大、盈利能力更强的公司，但仍经历工资下降。这些收入下降现象还集中在任职时间较长的员工群体中。研究结果与员工在并购引发的职业转换中失去有价值的岗位特定溢价这一解释相一致。

title: Winners and Losers from the Protestant Reformation: An Analysis of the Network of European Universities
title_zh: 宗教改革的赢家与输家：欧洲大学网络分析
title_primary: 宗教改革的赢家与输家：欧洲大学网络分析
title_secondary: Winners and Losers from the Protestant Reformation: An Analysis of the Network of European Universities
authors: de la Croix, David, Morault, Pauline
abstract: Using a new database of European academics, we build a network of universities that is based on professors’ mobility. We describe how the network was altered following the Protestant Reformation. We focus on fragmentation and on universities’ centrality. Dyadic regressions confirm that geography and vernacular languages were important for mobility, but did not substitute for religion. We compare simulated networks with and without religious identity. Most universities lose centrality in the simulated religious network compared to the non-religious one. As publications per university are correlated with centrality, the loss of connectedness of many universities after the Reformation contributed to their scientific decline.
abstract_zh: 基于欧洲学者新数据库，我们构建了以教授流动为基础的大学网络，并描述了宗教改革后该网络的变化。研究聚焦于网络碎片化与大学中心性。二元回归分析证实，地理因素与地方语言对学者流动具有重要影响，但并未取代宗教的作用。通过对比含宗教身份与不含宗教身份的模拟网络，发现多数大学在含宗教身份的模拟网络中中心性低于不含宗教身份的网络。由于大学论文发表数量与中心性相关，宗教改革后众多大学连通性的下降导致了其科学地位的衰落。

title: Impartial observer theorem with ambiguity
title_zh: 含模糊性的公正观察者定理
title_primary: 含模糊性的公正观察者定理
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper revisits the debate between Harsanyi and Rawls on collective decision-making with impartiality (Veil of Ignorance), focusing on how different levels of uncertainty influence the resulting social welfare functions. By incorporating ambiguity into the Impartial Observer framework, the paper constructs a continuum of compromise positions between Harsanyi’s utilitarian approach and Rawls’s maximin rule. In the proposed model, the independence between the uncertainty faced by the Impartial Observer over the distributions of identities and the uncertainty faced by each individual over the distributions of outcomes allows us to introduce ambiguity on both identity acts and/or outcome acts to explore various configurations where the Impartial Observer’s preference representation changes based on the type and level of uncertainty considered. The results offer a more nuanced understanding of impartiality in social choice contexts and help clarify the philosophical foundations of the Harsanyi–Rawls debate.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了哈萨尼与罗尔斯关于公正集体决策（无知之幕）的辩论，聚焦于不同程度的不确定性如何影响由此产生的社会福利函数。通过将模糊性纳入公正观察者框架，本文构建了介于哈萨尼功利主义方法与罗尔斯最大最小规则之间的连续折中立场。在所提出的模型中，公正观察者面临的身份分布不确定性与每个个体面临的结果分布不确定性之间的独立性，使我们得以在身份行为及/或结果行为上引入模糊性，以探索各种配置，其中公正观察者的偏好表示随所考虑的不确定性的类型和水平而变化。研究结果增进了对社会选择情境中公正性的细致理解，并有助于澄清哈萨尼-罗尔斯辩论的哲学基础。
